token_invalid: token invalid or expired (Discogs → Settings → Developers)
rate_limited: Discogs rate limit (60 requests per minute), please try again in a moment
no_request_token: Discogs did not return a request token
no_access_token: Discogs did not return an access token
not_configured: Discogs is not set up (Settings → Discogs)
no_identity: Discogs did not say whom the token belongs to
not_in_collection: The record is not in the collection (or the collection has not been synced yet)
instance_unknown: Collection instance unknown: sync the collection
